newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up, but package trims gains.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up, but package trims gains.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended higher on Friday, but early gains were trimmed after the government announced it would abolish regulatory duty and cut taxes in its economic reform package, dealers said.

"Synthetic stocks slipped after the government announcement to abolish regulatory duty," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "But the market will react properly in its special session later in the afternoon," dealer Rony Byramjee said.
The index rose 6.74 points, or 0.42 percent, to end at 1,620.12 from early high of 1,628.06. Gainers led losers 107 to 103. PTCL rose 0.30 rupees to 30.85. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
